title: Records related to Colin R. McMillan

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Records related to Colin R. McMillan
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records related to Colin R. McMillan, who served as the Assistant Secretary of Defense for Production and Logistics from March 5, 1990, to December 11, 1992, under the George H.W. Bush administration. 

Official Correspondence & Memoranda: Letters, policy directives, and briefing memos sent to or from Colin R. McMillan, including communications with then-Secretary of Defense Dick Cheney and/or former Secretary of Defense Frank Carlucci. 
Calendar and Meeting Logs: Daily schedules, visitor logs, and agendas for his tenure (1990–1992).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Sincerely,

Charles Kallas

title: Public Information Act Request — Habitual Offender and Criminal Gang/Organization Charging and Conviction Data (2021–2026) (Georgia Bureau of Investigation)

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: Public Information Act Request — Habitual Offender and Criminal Gang/Organization Charging and Conviction Data (2021–2026) (Georgia Bureau of Investigation)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

This request covers the five-year period from August 2021 through August 2026 and asks for case-level data on all charges filed in the state of Georgia under the following provisions of the Maryland Criminal Law Article:
- Habitual offender / mandatory sentencing for repeat violent offenders —GA Code §17-10-7
- Participation in a criminal gang/criminal organization — GA Code §16-15-4

For each of the statutes listed above, I am requesting the following, in electronic/spreadsheet format if available (e.g., an export from the Maryland Judiciary's case management system rather than individual scanned dockets):
- Case number, filing date, and statute(s) charged for every case in which a charge under one of the above statutes was filed
- Disposition of each charge (e.g., convicted, acquitted, nolle prossed, placed on the stet docket, dismissed) and disposition date
- Sentence imposed where a conviction resulted, including whether the enhancement itself was applied at sentencing or was withdrawn/not pursued
- Defendant's race, sex, and age at time of charging, to the extent maintained in the case record
- Presiding judge and assigned prosecuting entity, if reflected in the docket

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jenny Wadhwa
